$comment: Mission 1.85.0. Machine-readable roadmap from 'SROS can prove market or procurement activity exists' to 'SROS can identify, compare and select real product opportunities'. Written by hand from five read-only analyses and checked by packages/opportunity-engine/python/tests/test_business_evidence_roadmap.py against the repository (source catalog, EvidenceDimension enum, dependency graph shape). It is a plan, not a permission: nothing here authorises acquisition, a review verdict, a model call or a score.
operator_decisions_in_force: D4: NO further synthesis on the current TED packet; Mission 1.84 is CLOSED for it
NO V11; NO Opportunity #2; historical V1-V10 artifacts immutable; gates v1.2.0-v1.6.0 not reopened
TED remains one existing source of category-scope market and budget evidence, not a target

business_dimensions.bound: published award totals for one CPV division; category scope; not market size or growth
public-sector contracting authorities only; never 'would buy THIS'
BT-161 includes options and renewals; not money paid
one count of help questions under one tag; not people, not severity, not a shared problem
nearest proxy only; award totals are not realised expenditure

business_dimensions.ontology_note: a qualifier on PROBLEM_OR_NEED, not a dimension
PROBLEM_OR_NEED plus SOLUTION_GAP, bounded; no new member
the member requires paid or committed to pay; a stated hypothetical has no member (gap G4)
explicitly refused by SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION never_means; maps to nothing
no public statement measures retention; structural, not legal
COMPETITIVE_SUPPLY never means competitors are weak; a low rating on a competitor listing is SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION scoped to that product

independence_findings.finding: levels.py counts every non-UNKNOWN group, including DECLARED_DEPENDENT groups, as a group of established independence; two dependent clusters would reach Level 2 with no proof that the clusters are independent of each other
no code path writes an independence group or a non-UNKNOWN state; the only interpreter hard-codes UNKNOWN and create_independence_group has only test callers

evidence_independence_groups is claim-scoped with free-text detection_method; there is no place for a KNOWN_INDEPENDENT proof, no rule version column, no cross-claim origin id, no supersession; raw_records.parent_record_id exists and is filled on 0 of 325 rows
author identity is never acquired, so one user repeating a claim cannot be detected; a per-source keyed pseudonym would need a privacy review before collection
every held and candidate first-person source measures a platform-recorded quantity; a second route to the same platform is a copy, not corroboration

publisher-declared canonical URL or identical body hash across outlets

dependence_rule_invariants: a rule may move a record from UNKNOWN to KNOWN_DEPENDENT only; no match never yields KNOWN_INDEPENDENT
different platform, URL, timestamp or author handle never implies independence
exact or normalised hashes and source-native fields only; no embeddings or similarity (D-12)
no rule is activated before I-HAZARD is resolved

no evidence dimension and no approving source

no WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY source at any grain

market and budget activity is the one area already covered

mission_1_85_1.title: First-Person Structured Evaluation Source Qualification V1
mission_1_85_1.goal: Establish, on retrieved first-party documents, whether at least one source in F-REVIEW or F-ISSUE can be approved under local-private-research-v1 for a documented official route that exposes a source-native rating, label or duplicate relation, and select exactly one or record a documented no-go.
in_scope: freeze a bounded candidate list before any retrieval: the registered apple-app-store, google-play, steam and github, plus at most four unregistered candidates named in the brief as unverified
retrieve first-party terms, API documentation, robots directives and licences only (documentation requests, no research data)
for each candidate record the six activity assessments, route, field selection, rate limits and whether the rating, label or duplicate field is exposed by the official route
append a local-private-research-v1 review only where retrieved evidence supports a verdict; never infer from silence
register an unregistered candidate only if its review can be written on retrieved evidence
select exactly one qualified source and resource, or record the documented no-go with the next decision
out_of_scope: any collector, normalizer, extractor, record kind, migration or research-data request
reliability assessments, independence groups, scores, opportunities
reopening TED synthesis or gates v1.2.0-v1.6.0
mission_1_85_1.stop_rule: if no candidate reaches an approving local verdict with all six activities granted, stop and hand the operator a two-way decision: the semantic-extraction contract track (N08) or a documented product decision that would satisfy GitHub's open-access publication condition
done_when: every frozen candidate has a recorded outcome with first-party citations
one source and resource is selected with its exposed structured fields, or the no-go is recorded
the roadmap node N01 is marked done and N02's family is fixed

recorded_debt_not_fixed: lexical intervention-class grounding is not semantic validity
